51528798.protein: Induced myeloid leukemia cell differentiation protein Mcl-1
51528798.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to N-terminal his6-tagged human recombinant Mcl-1 expressed in Escherichia coli assessed as dissociation constant by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) using N-terminal his6-tagged human recombinant Mcl-1 expressed in Escherichia coli. The protein was immobilized on a CM5 sensor chip via amine coupling. The running buffer was HBS-EP+ (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20). Compounds were diluted in running buffer and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 μM at a flow rate of 30 μL/min. Association and dissociation phases were 180 and 300 s, respectively. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 evaluation software. The dissociation constant (Kd) was calculated from the association rate constant (kon) and dissociation rate constant (koff) using the equation Kd = koff/kon. The kon and koff values were determined by fitting the sensorgrams to a 1:1 Langmuir binding model. The SPR data for compounds 12–21 are shown in Figure S1 in the Supporting Information. The SPR data for compounds 22–29 are shown in Figure S2 in the Supporting Information.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: HBS-EP+ (10 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20)
